end.summary:
Practised regional diversity through festivals and dress.
Compared Pongal and Makar Sankranti as different forms of shared seasonal celebration.
Explained shared threads: common joy, seasonal ideas, and reasons beneath different actions.
Discussed phiran in Kashmir and lungi in Kerala as clothing suited to climate.
Teach-back was not completed because Riya stopped the lesson.
end.parentNote: Riya practised noticing both differences and shared ideas across festivals and clothing. They used the method of comparing examples, then identifying the common feeling or reason; this worked especially well for Pongal and Makar Sankranti. No clear mix-up was seen, so there was no correction needed later in the lesson. At home, invite them to compare one festival from two regions using “different form, shared idea.”
